ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   D. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Manners of to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

5. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in.
   D. Use Belief in to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Enlightened Beings able to: has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings able to:.
   D. Use The Enlightened Beings able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.
   C. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.
   B. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.
   C. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Names of Scriptures able to: has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Names of Scriptures able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures able to:.

13. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

14. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   C. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
